cases.title: 卡通情景喜剧模板
cases.block_reason: 主题、指定台词、片尾等尚未填写；示例值不是确认需求。
cases.prompt_original:
Make a 60-second 16:9 cartoon sitcom episode for [who will watch, e.g. people who follow our channel], playing [where, e.g. YouTube and Shorts]. Use only the names, facts and lines below as given; invent the story, the jokes and an original cast around them, and no real people or existing characters.

A 2D TV-cartoon look: thick dark outlines that wobble slightly, flat colour, big round eyes, noodle arms. Two characters with clearly different voices and one small non-speaking creature.
